run_latent_upscale_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionLatentUpscalePipeline to upscale a low-res image by 2x using a text prompt
encode_prompt_for_upscaling: encode a text prompt into CLIP embeddings for use with the latent upscale pipeline
retrieve_latents_from_encoder: retrieve latents from a VAE encoder output using sample or argmax mode
prepare_latents_for_upscale: prepare random noise latents scaled by the scheduler init sigma for the upscale pipeline
check_inputs_for_upscale: validate prompt, image, and embedding inputs before running the latent upscale pipeline
